sources.entry: BookLore | Book library manager and reader with metadata fetching and OPDS

summary.one_liner: BookLore is a self-hosted book library manager and reader that organizes ebooks, PDFs and comics, fetches metadata, and syncs with e-readers and OPDS apps.
summary.what_it_does: BookLore brings a personal book collection into one self-hosted app. It offers smart shelves, including rule-based Magic Shelves, filters and full-text search. It fetches covers, descriptions, reviews and ratings from Google Books, Open Library and Amazon, and metadata is editable. A built-in browser reader opens PDFs, EPUBs and comics with annotations, highlights and reading progress. Devices can sync through Kobo, any OPDS-compatible app, or KOReader. The BookDrop feature watches a folder, detects new files, enriches their metadata and queues them for review before import. Multiple users can have separate shelves, progress and preferences, using local or OIDC authentication. Books can also be sent to a Kindle or an email address. The README notes that BookOrbit is the official successor and that BookLore is entering maintenance mode.
use_cases: read PDFs, EPUBs and comics in the browser
sync reading progress with Kobo or KOReader
auto-import new book files from a watched folder
how_to_run: Create a .env file with database, user ID, timezone and DISK_TYPE settings
Create docker-compose.yml using ghcr.io/booklore-app/booklore:latest with a MariaDB service
Open the web UI on port 6060 and create an admin account
notable: BookDrop watched-folder import with automatic metadata enrichment
Built-in in-browser reader with annotations and highlights
Supports Kobo, OPDS apps and KOReader sync
Network storage mode (DISK_TYPE=NETWORK) that disables file writes
caveats: Network storage (NAS, NFS, SMB/CIFS) is unsupported and untested; file operations are local-only, and network storage issues are closed without investigation
BookLore is in maintenance mode; active development has moved to BookOrbit
Requires running a MariaDB database alongside the app
